key_mapping.matching_rule: Absolute difference from a calibration reference is less than 59; these are default flash values, not measurements of the owner's camera

manual_interpretation.startup: The predicate requires drive result 2, raw AF/AE LOCK 0x400 and DISPLAY 0x800, with settings state 1. This agrees with the manual's documented temporary service entry; the drive-position label is corroborated by that procedure rather than an independent live measurement.
manual_interpretation.override: The separate RAM-override consumer's UI event bit 0x80 maps to DELETE. Full timing/state activation remains unresolved; no standalone button recipe is established.

usb_preparation_manual_review.routing: 0x401e96eb decodes (bmRequestType & 0x60) >> 5. Vendor type reaches 0x401eed80 only when descriptor mode is 2.
usb_preparation_manual_review.request_zero: 0x401eed80 accepts bRequest zero; wIndex zero calls 0x401eedad, nonzero calls 0x401eedef. wValue is not read in these two routines.
usb_preparation_manual_review.index_zero: Clears two maintenance-state words, sets bulk phase 3 and receive state 5, prepares an endpoint and control status. No flash-writing routine is identified in this reviewed path.
usb_preparation_manual_review.index_nonzero: Restores bulk phase 3, readies pending transfer state and resets the transfer cursor. Historical host calls name the matching control preparation preBulkRead_CZ30.
usb_preparation_manual_review.scope: These are transfer-preparation operations after vendor mode selection. They do not establish entry from ordinary PC/PTP mode, a key-extraction command, or complete request validation.
